name: scriptschedule
description: Capacitor native shell for the ScriptSchedule web app (index.html). The web app itself has no build step; www/ is a plain copy of the static files that ship inside the native app.

scripts.sync-www: cp index.html privacy.html manifest.json sw.js favicon.ico icon-152.png icon-167.png icon-180.png icon-192.png icon-512.png www/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync-www && npx cap sync
